case_chains.selection_reason: Iconic currency trade; decision attribution and evidence gaps are important training constraints.
case_chains.predecision_evidence: No authenticated pretrade Quantum memo or letter found. A later primary central-bank account documents observable policy conditions, not the managers' contemporaneous stated motivation.
case_chains.event_chain: BoE describes UK/German policy divergence, failed September 16 sterling support and evening suspension from ERM. Rate escalation did not sustain the peg.
case_chains.position_and_attribution: Druckenmiller's later speech attributes the initial GBP idea/trade to himself and the push for greater size to Soros. It describes an initial $1.5bn short against roughly $7bn capital; proposed and achieved final notional must not be conflated.
case_chains.outcome_evidence: Soros's own 2016 essay acknowledges substantial profits for hedge-fund investors from the 1992 episode.
case_chains.retrospective_status: The portfolio attribution is 2015 hindsight, the own-profit acknowledgement 2016. Neither authenticates a pre-entry reasoning log.
competing_explanations: Other market participants and official policy choices affected the event
Large notional may amplify profit and path risk
A pegged FX structure is not equivalent to a generic undervalued stock
case_chains.audit_lesson: Test policy contradiction and payoff mechanics; never turn famous leverage into a default user sizing rule.
missing: Original trade ledger and pretrade mandate/risk limits

case_chains.position_and_attribution: The 1997 essay self-reports aggregate fund investments of $2.5bn, not a single telecom trade. It acknowledges earlier fund trades sometimes opposed by Soros. No exact August 1998 security inventory retrieved.
case_chains.data_rejection: The own-site $980 billion telecom amount is apparently erroneous and excluded; no unverified replacement number used.
case_chains.event_chain: Russian authorities' August 17 devaluation/restructuring measures are documented in IMF Survey.
case_chains.outcome_evidence: Contemporary Irish Times reporting quotes Druckenmiller admitting up to $2bn of Russia losses across the Quantum group. This is not an audited trade-by-trade P&L.
case_chains.hypothesis_failure: Reform/ownership optimism and external-rescue assumptions did not remove currency, sovereign funding and bank/collateral risks. The losses cannot all be assigned to telecom equity.
case_chains.interpretation_status: Audit synthesis; attribution across assets remains unresolved.
case_chains.audit_lesson: Separate corporate institutional reform from sovereign solvency, currency convertibility and financing survival; document which assets each thesis actually supports.
